extracted.name: Shredded Carrots
extracted.description: Learn how to shred carrots for cakes, grated carrot salads, and more! They have a delicious fresh taste and crisp texture.
instruction_lines: Place a box grater on a cutting board. Pick up a carrot by its thick end, and run its tip down the large holes of the grater. Continue this downward shredding motion until about 2 inches of the carrot remain intact. Stop here to avoid cutting your fingers on the holes of the box grater.
